$comment: Read by provisioning/Provision-GovernanceDashboard.ps1 and checked by tools/validate_dashboard.py. Views are added to the lists; the page shows each view in a List web part.

page.name: Governance-Dashboard
page.title: Governance dashboard
page.intro: What needs action across the governance lists. Each panel is a filtered view of a list: open it to work the items. Site attestation, ownership, inactive-site and oversharing reports are in SharePoint Advanced Management (links below).
page.links:
SharePoint Advanced Management and automation

  • Active sites: sharing, owners and site policies
  • Policies: site attestation, site ownership, inactive sites, restricted site creation
  • Reports: data access governance (oversharing) and site access reviews
  • Azure Automation jobs log for Set-SiteGovernanceBaseline: success comes from the ###RESULT### line, not the flow (G-10)

views.title: Needs action
views.heading: Access requests needing action
views.query: <Where><In><FieldRef Name="Status"/><Values><Value Type="Choice">Submitted</Value><Value Type="Choice">Approved - awaiting AD group change</Value><Value Type="Choice">Approved - PIM eligible assignment pending</Value></Values></In></Where><OrderBy><FieldRef Name="Created"/></OrderBy>

views.title: Ending soon
views.heading: Guests ending in 14 days or awaiting an owner decision
views.query: <Where><Or><Eq><FieldRef Name="Status"/><Value Type="Choice">Removal pending owner decision</Value></Eq><And><Eq><FieldRef Name="Status"/><Value Type="Choice">Active</Value></Eq><Leq><FieldRef Name="AccessEndDate"/><Value Type="DateTime"><Today OffsetDays="14"/></Value></Leq></And></Or></Where><OrderBy><FieldRef Name="AccessEndDate"/></OrderBy>

views.title: External sharing on
views.heading: Sites open to guests or not yet confirmed

views.title: Awaiting decision
views.heading: File shares awaiting a decision
views.query: <Where><In><FieldRef Name="Status"/><Values><Value Type="Choice">Registered</Value><Value Type="Choice">Awaiting owner decision</Value><Value Type="Choice">Disposition required</Value></Values></In></Where><OrderBy><FieldRef Name="Created"/></OrderBy>
